title: The `podman build` command's `--tag` and `--manifest` options should error if set to the same value
body: In Buildah, there is validation to make sure `--manifest` and `--tag` are not set to the same value. Podman lacks this validation. Thus, `podman build --manifest myimage:latest --tag myimage:latest` does not error, but replacing `podman build` with `buildah build` would. This should be fixed by adding the appropriate validation to Podman.
